name: spaces_create_flow
description: Save a Space workflow as a reusable flow. Walks the graph connected to `startNodeId` and works out which nodes the runner fills in and which return results. `dryRun` shows that choice without creating anything. The flow is private to its owner.

allowRemix.description: Lets others copy the graph. Default false.

dryRun.description: Return what would be exposed without creating the flow.

inputs.description: Replaces the derived inputs. Name nodes only — `field` picks one generator setting.

startNodeId.description: Any node of the chain to save; the whole connected graph is captured, both directions.
